rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: Filings for the leader election closed on 21 January with no candidate other than 土井たか子党首, and her uncontested third election was decided (term two years); after the 3 p.m. close on the 21st the head of the election headquarters declared that the headquarters confirmed 土井たか子さん's election as party leader.
